        ### Question
        Attended a scheduled review, a 50-year-old man diagnosed with polyangiitis with granulomatosis 10 years previously and without treatment for 5 years is asymptomatic. What is the most advisable therapeutic attitude?

opb. Start treatment with cyclophosphamide.
opc. Start treatment with mycophenolate mofetil.
opd. Surveillance expectant.
